name: Furuse Michiko
source:
A former female announcer at NEK TV, she is now a well-known producer at the station. She was the most popular announcer before changing the direction of career.

She has a rivalry with Miho, whom she sees as her rival. She is willing to do whatever it takes to rise to the top, and will exchange sexual favors to do so.

She's famous for loving virgins.
